title: Decision Benchmark, ap-invoices, v0.10: results file
description: metadata.yaml of a results folder, and every scored results file, read as JSON. Every row says its lane. See docs/task-sets/ap-invoices/spec-v0.10.md, 'Leaderboards'.

row_kind.description: entry: a submission. baseline: published by us and ranked. floor: always approve, always hand over. reference: engine on perfect facts, shown but never ranked.

lane.description: model: one model, one call per case, no tools, no engine. system: anything with tools, a rules engine, a pipeline or an agent.

agent_variant.description: Agent track only: (a) rules as documents in the policy folder; (b) the same plus the check_rules tool.

input.description: gold_facts only for the reference row.

engine_version.description: Engine version that wrote the answer keys scored against.

rules_version.description: Rule sheet version of those answer keys.

scores.description: Filled by the scorer. Extra columns show "not submitted" when the entry left the field out, never 0.

allOf.description: The model lane takes no tools, so it has no agent track.
Agent-track rows name their variant; other rows don't.
Only the reference row runs on gold facts, and it sits on the system lane.
